OperatingGuideText1:
The gauge at the top shows the opening hours (max. 8 hours).
When the gauge is fully depleted, the day is over.
Serve your customers well to earn more!
OperatingGuideText2:
Customers will show up over the day. Once they're seated, icons will appear above their heads:
ready to order, waiting for the order, or waiting to pay. Both you and the maids can serve customers.
(Some frustrated customers can only be served by maids though!)
OperatingGuideText3:
Maids on waitress duty will take orders, serve, and take payment,
while maids on chef duty will cook once they receive orders.
You can help out by interacting with tables or the kitchen counter with the Z key/A button.
(Of course, you could leave it all to the maids if you're feeling lazy.)

SettlementTitle:
Dear Manager,

Thank you very much for turning Fuwa Fuwa into such a wonderful place. Even though we started from rock bottom, we were able to welcome so many masters and ladies back home and put smiles on their faces. We also gathered such a lovely group of maids that have made the cafe a lively place again. All of this is thanks to your hard work.
Although it's been a lot of fun, we've also run into a lot of difficulties along the way, haven't we? But every time, you've shown how much you care for the cafe and all of us, and that gave us the extra push we needed to pull through. We couldn't have done it without you. Thank you for looking after Fuwa Fuwa, and I hope you'll continue to take care of us from now on as well.
As Manager of Fuwa Fuwa, you've made the following accomplishments...
SettlementEnd: From the Maids of Fuwa Fuwa

OperatingGuideText4:
The management skill "Special Service Magic" temporarily raises the amount of payment received from your masters and ladies.
To activate the skill, you and your maids must work hard to fill up the skill gauge under the time gauge.
Activate the skill during peak hours for the best results!
OperatingGuideText5:
Three of the cafe's dining tables have been badly damaged.
The guy at the furniture store next door has promised to help fix them in his spare time, but it might take a while...
If you can go and help out at the furniture store, you might be able to get the tables repaired faster.
